officialChinese.name: 顺风而行
officialChinese.description:
迦娜的友军在朝她移动时获得移动速度。

迦娜的普攻和【和风守护】会附带一部分额外移动速度的额外魔法伤害。

officialEnglish.name: Tailwind
officialEnglish.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

officialChinese.name: 飓风呼啸
officialChinese.description: 迦娜改变气压和温度，在目标区域召唤小型风暴，风暴体积随时间增大。她可以再次施放该技能来释放风暴。风暴会朝向施放方向飞行，对沿途的所有单位造成伤害和击飞效果。
officialChinese.tooltip: 迦娜召唤一道在{{ maxduration }}秒里持续聚集的飓风，随后沿路猛刮出去。飓风对目标造成<magicDamage>{{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }}魔法伤害</magicDamage>和{{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }}秒<status>击飞</status>。移动距离、伤害和<status>击飞</status>时长都基于飓风聚集的时长。迦娜可以<recast>再次施放</recast>来提前将飓风刮出去。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Howling Gale
officialEnglish.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over {{ maxduration }} seconds then blows along its path. It deals <magicDamage>{{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }} seconds. The distance, damage, and <status>Knock Up</status> duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can <recast>Recast</recast> to send the tornado early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 和风守护
officialChinese.description: 迦娜召唤出一个空气元素灵体，来被动地提升她的移动速度，并使她能够穿越单位。她也可以主动激活这个技能，来对一个敌人造成伤害和减速效果。
officialChinese.tooltip:
被动：迦娜获得{{ totalms }}移动速度并处在幽灵状态。

主动：迦娜的风灵打击一名敌人，对其造成持续{{ slowduration }}秒的{{ totalslow }}减速和{{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }}魔法伤害。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Zephyr
officialEnglish.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Passive: Janna gains {{ totalms }} Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 风暴之眼
officialChinese.description: 迦娜制造出一阵防御性的气旋，来为目标友军或防御塔吸收即将到来的伤害，并提高目标的攻击力。
officialChinese.tooltip:
迦娜为一个友军或防御塔提供持续{{ shieldduration }}秒的{{ totalshield }}护盾值。在护盾存在时，该友军目标获得{{ totalad }}攻击力。

迦娜在每次用一个技能使一名敌方英雄的移动速度受损时，会使这个冷却时间缩短{{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}%。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Eye Of The Storm
officialEnglish.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While shielded, they gain {{ totalad }} Attack Damage.

Janna refunds {{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 复苏季风
officialChinese.description: 迦娜召唤魔法风暴围绕自己，将敌人击退。在风暴平息后，当技能仍处在激活状态时，和风将治疗附近的友军。
officialChinese.tooltip: 迦娜召唤一阵魔法季风，<status>击退</status>附近的敌人们然后在{{ duration }}秒里持续治疗附近的友军共<healing>{{ totalheal }}生命值</healing>。移动或使用技能都会提前结束这阵季风。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Monsoon
officialEnglish.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, <status>Knocking Back</status> nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> over {{ duration }} seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 皮克斯，仙灵伙伴
officialChinese.description: 每当皮克斯正在跟随的英雄进行攻击时，皮克斯就会发射魔法飞弹。这些飞弹会自动寻敌，但也会被其它单位所拦截。

officialEnglish.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
officialEnglish.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

officialChinese.name: 闪耀长枪
officialChinese.description: 璐璐和皮克斯各自发射一个穿刺飞弹，对命中的所有敌人造成伤害和重度减速效果。
officialChinese.tooltip:
璐璐和皮克斯各发射一束贯穿魔弹，造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害和在{{ slowduration }}秒里持续衰减的{{ slowamount*-100 }}%减速。

如果两束魔弹都命中了相同的一名敌人，那么会对其造成额外的{{ bonusmissiledamage }}魔法伤害。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Glitterlance
officialEnglish.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Enemies take {{ bonusmissiledamage }} magic damage from additional bolts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 奇思妙想
officialChinese.description: 如果对友军施放，会暂时增加目标友军的攻击速度和移动速度。如果对敌人施放，会将一名敌方英雄变成可爱的动物，使其无法攻击或施法。
officialChinese.tooltip:
当用在一名友方身上时，璐璐提供{{ totalms }}移动速度和{{ asbonus*100 }}%攻击速度，持续{{ msduration }}秒。

当用在一名敌人身上时，璐璐会将其变形{{ ccduration }}秒。 {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

label: 移动速度和攻击速度持续时间
攻击速度
变形持续时间

officialEnglish.name: Whimsy
officialEnglish.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants {{ totalms }} Move Speed and {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ msduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

label: Move Speed and Attack Speed Duration
Attack Speed
Polymorph Duration

officialChinese.name: 帮忙，皮克斯！
officialChinese.description: 如果对友军施放，会命令皮克斯跳到一名友军身上进行保护，之后会跟随并协助目标（而不是璐璐）进行攻击。如果对敌人施放，皮克斯会跳到敌人身上造成伤害，之后会跟随并提供目标的视野。
officialChinese.tooltip:
在对一名友方施放时，皮克斯会跳到该友方处并提供持续{{ pixonallyduration }}秒的皮克斯，仙灵伙伴。如果该友方是一名英雄，那么皮克斯还会提供持续{{ shieldduration }}秒的{{ totalshield }}护盾值。

在对一名敌方英雄使用时，皮克斯会妨碍该英雄，造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害，并提供其真实视野，持续{{ pixonenemyduration }}秒。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Help, Pix!
officialEnglish.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for {{ pixonallyduration }} seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight of them for {{ pixonenemyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 狂野生长
officialChinese.description: 璐璐让她的友军变大，击飞目标附近的敌人，同时为她的友军提供大量生命值加成。接下来的数秒内，该友军会获得一个减少附近敌人速度的光环。
officialChinese.tooltip: 璐璐使一名友方英雄巨大化，并<status>击飞</status>周围的敌人{{ knockbackduration }}秒。巨大化的友方英雄会获得<healing>{{ totalbonushealth }}最大生命值</healing>并使周围的敌人们<status>减速</status>{{ slowpercent }}%，持续{{ buffduration }}秒。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Wild Growth
officialEnglish.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> surrounding enemies for {{ knockbackduration }} second. The enlarged ally gains <healing>{{ totalbonushealth }} max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 踏浪之行
officialChinese.description: 每当娜美的技能命中友方英雄时，他们都会暂时获得移动速度加成。

officialEnglish.name: Surging Tides
officialEnglish.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

officialChinese.name: 碧波之牢
officialChinese.description: 朝着目标区域放出一个泡泡，对命中的所有敌人造成伤害和晕眩效果。
officialChinese.tooltip: 娜美掷出一个泡泡，<status>晕眩</status>敌人{{ stunduration }}秒并造成<magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }}魔法伤害</magicDamage>。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Aqua Prison
officialEnglish.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Nami hurls a bubble, <status>Stunning</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 冲击之潮
officialChinese.description: 释放一股在友方英雄和敌方英雄之间交替流动的水流，治疗友军并伤害敌军。
officialChinese.tooltip:
娜美释放一股在友方英雄和敌方英雄之间交替弹跳的水流。每个目标只会被弹到一次，并且水流至多可弹{{ maxtargets }}个目标。
  • 为友方英雄回复{{ totalheal }}生命值并弹向附近的一名敌方英雄身上。
  • 对敌方英雄造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害并弹向附近的一名友方英雄身上。
    每次弹跳会使伤害和治疗数额修正{{ bouncescaling }}。 {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Ebb and Flow
officialEnglish.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets.
  • Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.
  • Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
    The damage and healing value is modified by {{ bouncescaling }} each bounce. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 唤潮之佑
officialChinese.description: 短时间里强化一个友军英雄。友军的普通攻击和技能会对其目标造成额外伤害和减速效果。
officialChinese.tooltip: 娜美强化一位友方英雄的下{{ hitcount }}次普通攻击和技能，持续{{ buffduration }}秒，使其可以对目标造成持续{{ slowduration }}秒的{{ totalslow }}<status>减速</status>，并造成额外的<magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害</magicDamage>。 {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
officialEnglish.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Nami empowers an allied champion's next {{ hitcount }} Attacks and Abilities for {{ buffduration }} seconds, causing them to <status>Slow</status> their targets by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }}s and deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 怒涛之啸
officialChinese.description: 召唤一阵巨大的怒涛，击飞、减速并伤害沿途的所有敌人。被怒涛命中的友方英雄会获得【踏浪之行】的双倍加速效果。
officialChinese.tooltip:
娜美召唤一阵怒涛，造成0.5秒击飞，{{ slowamount }}%减速并造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害。减速的持续时间会基于怒涛的行进距离而提升，至多持续{{ maxslowduration }}秒。

被怒涛命中的友方英雄会获得踏浪之行的双倍效果。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Tidal Wave
officialEnglish.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}%, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to {{ maxslowduration }} seconds.

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 灵魂吸取
officialChinese.description: 莫甘娜从她的敌人身上吸取灵魂，在对英雄、大型小兵、中型野怪和大型野怪造成技能伤害时获得治疗效果。

officialEnglish.name: Soul Siphon
officialEnglish.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

officialChinese.name: 暗之禁锢
officialChinese.description: 莫甘娜用黑暗魔法将一名敌人禁锢在原地，迫使其感受自己造成的痛苦并对其造成魔法伤害。
officialChinese.tooltip: 莫甘娜掷出一团星火来<status>禁锢</status>命中的第一个敌人{{ rootduration }}秒，并造成<magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害</magicDamage>。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Dark Binding
officialEnglish.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Morgana hurls a blast of starfire that <status>Roots</status> the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 折磨之影
officialChinese.description: 莫甘娜在一个区域施放一团诅咒之影，对胆敢站在她黑色环形之中的敌人造成伤害。敌人会持续受到魔法伤害，并且生命值越低受到伤害越高。
officialChinese.tooltip:
莫甘娜点燃一个区域{{ wduration }}秒，每秒对区域内的敌人造成{{ totalmindamage }}魔法伤害，基于目标的已损失生命值，伤害可最多提升{{ totalmaxdamage }}。

每当莫甘娜被灵魂吸取治疗时，这个技能的冷却时间就会减少{{ cdrefundpercent*100 }}%。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Tormented Shadow
officialEnglish.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Morgana ignites the ground for {{ wduration }} seconds, dealing {{ totalmindamage }} magic damage per second, increased by up to {{ totalmaxdamage }} based on the targets' missing Health.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundpercent*100 }}% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 黑暗之盾
officialChinese.description: 莫甘娜为一名友方英雄涂上一层保护性的星火屏障，在被打破之前吸收魔法伤害和限制效果。
officialChinese.tooltip: 莫甘娜为一名友方英雄提供<shield>{{ totalshieldstrength }}魔法护盾</shield>，持续{{ shieldduration }}秒。护盾会阻挡<status>限制</status>和<status>定身</status>效果，直至被打破为止。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Black Shield
officialEnglish.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.
officialEnglish.tooltip: Morgana grants an ally champion <shield>{{ totalshieldstrength }} Magic Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The shield prevents <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects until it breaks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialChinese.name: 灵魂镣铐
officialChinese.description: 莫甘娜全力释放她的星界能量，与此同时，她的羽翼会解除束缚并且会悬浮在地面上。她将黑暗痛苦组成的锁链抽击到附近的敌方英雄身上，获得移动速度。锁链会减速并造成初段伤害，并在一段延迟后，晕眩那些未能挣脱的敌方英雄。
officialChinese.tooltip:
莫甘娜将她自己与附近的敌方英雄用锁链铐在一起，造成{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害和{{ slowpercent }}%减速效果。在{{ chainduration }}秒后，仍未挣断锁链的敌人会受到{{ totaldamage }}魔法伤害并被晕眩{{ stunduration }}秒。

在施放这个技能时，莫甘娜会获得{{ hastepercent }}%移动速度。{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialEnglish.name: Soul Shackles
officialEnglish.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.
officialEnglish.tooltip:
Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent }}%. After {{ chainduration }} seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

While casting this Ability, Morgana gains {{ hastepercent }}% Move Speed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
